newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Donnkenny cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Donnkenny cut to neutral.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Thursday it downgraded Donnkenny Inc to neutral from buy, after the company late November 6 announced its auditors resigned and its controller and assistant controller were reassigned to non-financial responsibilities.
-- "In light of these significant changes, we choose to stay on the sidelines until the EPS and management issues at (Donnkenny) are clearer," Rodman said in a report.
-- Donnkenny said KPMG resigned as its auditors, replaced by Deloitte and Touche LLP.
-- It also named Stewart Levy as chief financial officer.

-- Donnkenny designs, manufactures, imports and markets a broad line of moderately priced women's sportswear and sleepwear. It also makes, imports and markets men's, women's and children's sportswear and intimate apparel featuring licensed cartoon character images.
-- Rodman said Donnkenny is expected to report its third quarter results next week, mostly likely on November 14. --
